body:
BTC/USD

Bitcoin price trades at $64,830 on Thursday, holding above the 50-day Exponential Moving Average (EMA) at $64,670 but still capped well below the 100-day EMA at $67,049 and the 200-day EMA at $72,564. [...] Bitcoin (BTC) is a decentralized peer-to-peer digital currency originally designed to facilitate digital payments across the globe. Launched by anonymous figure Satoshi Nakamoto in 2009, Bitcoin's success largely depended on how it facilitated recorded ownership and facilitated the transfer of assets through a distributed ledger known as blockchain technology. [...] Bitcoin futures are contracts that enable traders to speculate on the price of Bitcoin without owning the underlying asset. Similar to other futures products, these contracts obligate investors to buy or sell Bitcoin for a predetermined price at a specific date.

Bitcoin is trading modestly higher, rebounding toward $78,650 after a volatile weekend session in which renewed U.S.-Iran military strikes and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole remarks pushed the September rate-hike probability to roughly 60%, driving BTC below $77,000 amid nearly $390 million in liquidations. Investors are weighing this macro-driven pullback against still-bullish underlying signals, including Michael Saylor's apparent resumption of Strategy's BTC purchases after a [...] purchases after a two-month pause, continued spot ETF demand, and Tom Lee's forecast that the pending CLARITY Act and slowing four-year cycle effects could fuel a strong Q4 rally toward six figures. Bitcoin remains up roughly 24-28% for August, on pace for its best monthly performance since late 2024, even as traders debate whether $78,000 support holds against fresh geopolitical and monetary policy headwinds. [...] Bitcoin is trading modestly lower as investors position ahead of Wednesday's crucial US CPI inflation report, which will heavily influence Fed rate-cut expectations for the September FOMC meeting.
